title: Is a flagged weld cracked?
intro: A = a weld is cracked, the prior P(A) = 0.02. B = the ultrasonic test flags the weld. The test flags 90 % of cracked welds, P(B | A) = 0.90, and 5 % of sound ones, P(B | A′) = 0.05. The total probability rule gives P(B) = 0.067, and Bayes' theorem gives P(A | B) = 0.018 / 0.067 = 0.2687: about one flagged weld in four is cracked.
